authority: Native Windows Server 2022 MSVC Win32 on x64
scope: First XNav shell only; software rendering and synthetic disconnected fixtures
observations: Day/dusk/night chrome follows the corresponding tokens.
Unavailable values use dashes and UNAVAILABLE labels.
Explicit simulator renders wind 16.2 kn, transducer depth 8.4 m, SOG 6.3 kn, COG 147 deg.
Paused values mute and show STALE 7s; SIMULATION PAUSED remains visible.
Legacy and Safe preserve stock interface layout; return to XNav restores shell.
limitations: Full product design is not implemented.
No real nautical chart readability acceptance.
Non-default DPI and touch hardware not validated.
Later source changes require a new native gate.
